name: FLOOR bench
description: Reproducible bench accompanying the article "Framing matters more than cipher choice: fixed versus context-adaptive lightweight encryption for medical IoT devices". It contains bare-metal Cortex-M4 firmware for seven authenticated-encryption implementations, an instruction-level emulator with a cycle model cross-checked against published Arduino Due measurements, a Bluetooth Low Energy radio energy model, traffic and link generators, the protection schemes (static, adaptive rule, learner, FLOOR and its variants), the node-day simulator, attack and traffic-analysis experiments, the figure scripts, and the raw results used in the article. Run ./run_all.sh to reproduce every table and figure (see README.md).
